headline: Gold Finder Adopts Semi-Annual Financial Reporting
summary: Gold Finder Resources Ltd. has announced the adoption of a semi-annual financial reporting schedule.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Scheduled to Report First-Quarter 2026 Earnings on May 7
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. is set to release its financial results for the first quarter of 2026 on May 7, with analysts projecting significant year-over-year earnings growth.

headline: Newmont's Lihir Gold Mine Launches National Mine Safety Week
summary: Newmont Corporation's Lihir operation in Papua New Guinea has officially kicked off National Mine Safety Week to emphasize its commitment to workforce safety and operational culture.

headline: MLG Oz Awarded Five-Year Contract at Newmont's Tanami Operations
summary: Mining services firm MLG Oz has secured a new five-year contract to provide integrated site services at Newmont's Tanami gold operations in Australia.

headline: Newmont Commences Sale Process for Akyem Gold Mine in Ghana
summary: Newmont Corporation has initiated a formal process to sell its Akyem gold mine in Ghana as part of a broader strategy to divest non-core assets and generate $2 billion in cash.

headline: GoldMining Inc. Commences 2026 Exploration Drill Program at São Jorge Project
summary: GoldMining Inc. has officially launched its 2026 exploration drilling campaign at the São Jorge gold project located in the Tapajós district of Pará State, Brazil.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Issues Shares Under Dividend Reinvestment and Option Plans
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. has issued 20,064 common shares through its dividend reinvestment plan and 7,689 shares via the exercise of employee stock options.

headline: Newmont Reports 2025 Gold Mineral Reserves
summary: Newmont Corporation announced its gold mineral reserves totaled 118.2 million attributable ounces at the end of 2025.

headline: Headwater Gold Identifies 'Meridian Zone' at Newmont-Funded Lodestar Project
summary: Headwater Gold announced results from a drill program at its Lodestar project in Nevada, which is fully funded by Newmont under an earn-in agreement.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Celebrates 20-Year Listing Anniversary on NYSE
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. marked its 20th anniversary of being listed on the New York Stock Exchange during the exchange's opening bell ceremony on May 6, 2026.

headline: Gold.com, Inc. Reports Fiscal Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
summary: Gold.com, Inc. announced its financial results for the fiscal third quarter ended March 31, 2026, reporting net income of $59.5 million and diluted earnings per share of $2.09.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Reports Record First-Quarter 2026 Financial Results
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. announced record financial performance for the first quarter of 2026, including US$901 million in revenue and US$582 million in net earnings.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Increases Quarterly Dividend by 18%
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. has declared a second quarterly cash dividend of US$0.195 per common share, representing an 18% increase compared to the same period in 2025.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Announces Election of Directors and Approval of Special Matters
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. announced the results of its 2026 Annual and Special Meeting of Shareholders, including the election of directors and the approval of its approach to executive compensation.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Announces Leadership Transition and Board Election Results
summary: Following the 2026 Annual and Special Meeting of Shareholders, Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. confirmed the election of its board members and announced a leadership transition.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Announces Director Share Transaction
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. reported that a director and person discharging managerial responsibilities, Jeane Hull, exercised vested long-term incentive plan grants and sold a portion of the resulting common shares.

headline: Agnico Eagle Announces C$14 Billion Investment in Ontario Gold Mines
summary: Agnico Eagle Mines Limited has committed to a C$14 billion investment in its Ontario gold mining portfolio by 2030, aiming to significantly boost annual gold production.

headline: Agnico Eagle Approves Hope Bay Investment Decision
summary: Agnico Eagle Mines Limited has officially approved an investment decision for its Hope Bay project, targeting annual gold production of over 400,000 ounces.

headline: Gold Finder Resources Reports Geological Findings at Eldorado and Gold Swarm
summary: Gold Finder Resources announced that geological mapping and geochemical analysis at its Eldorado and Gold Swarm projects indicate the presence of a large buried porphyry feeder source.

headline: Grafton Resources Announces Letter of Intent for Acquisition of Two Gold Projects from Newmont
summary: Grafton Resources has entered into a non-binding letter of intent to acquire two gold-focused exploration projects in Chile from Newmont USA Limited.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. has released its 2025 Sustainability Report, detailing the company's progress on ESG metrics and its updated materiality assessment.

headline: GoldMining Inc. Commences 2026 Exploration Drilling Program at Yarumalito Project
summary: GoldMining Inc. has officially launched its 2026 exploration drilling program at the Yarumalito gold-copper project located in Colombia.

headline: RBC Reports Contraction in Gold Royalty Valuations
summary: RBC Capital Markets noted that valuations for gold royalty companies have generally contracted, though larger-cap entities like Franco-Nevada have shown more resilience.
